note: 参数、统计、种子与成功阈值在 pilot 前冻结（计划 §7/§8）。正式测试解封前只允许一次有书面理由的修订（decision_log 记录）。

intervention.form: C = Z0 + eta * K_T(P_lambda) R_train, P_lambda = (1-lam) P_hard + lam P_aux, P_aux = original candidate hypergraph (row-stochastic, zero-degree self-loops)
intervention.tie_break: max val accuracy; ties -> smaller eta, then smaller lambda (grid iterated in ascending (eta, lambda) with strict improvement)

baselines.prop_original: row-stochastic kernel propagation of Z0 on original hypergraph; alpha grid [0.5,0.7,0.9,0.95]; ties -> smaller alpha
baselines.prop_soft: same on soft weights (max predicted-class fraction); alpha grid [0.5,0.7,0.9,0.95]
baselines.cs: official-style Correct&Smooth on the original hypergraph: S=D^{-1/2}(A+I)D^{-1/2}; autoscale residual correction; smooth with train reset; alpha1 x alpha2 in {0.5,0.7,0.9,0.95}^2 (16 fits); ties -> smaller alpha1 then alpha2; fixed 20 iterations per propagation
baselines.budget: candidate 16 evaluations; cs 16; each prop 4; all methods share identical predictor fit (same seed, same train mask) and identical Z0 within a block

data.split: stratified by class, 60/20/20 train/val/test; per class n_test=max(1,round(0.2*n_c)), n_val=max(1,round(0.2*n_c)), train=rest with >=1; n_c=1 -> train; n_c=2 -> 1 train 1 test
data.class_set: declared public task classes (cora 7, dblp 6, walmart 11); never derived from test labels
data.walmart_lp: seeds = 25% of train nodes; symmetric-normalized propagation on original structure, alpha=0.9, 50 steps; seed nodes overwritten with train labels

pilot.purpose: development only; numbers never enter formal main tables

formal.choose_10_or_20_before_unsealing: decision recorded in decision_log before test-label evaluation of aggregate statistics; default 10

metrics.correction_rates: corrected/wrong_changed with full-test-node denominator; conditional rates (init-wrong, init-right) reported separately

statistics.paired: candidate minus strongest-by-val standard baseline per block (baseline choice never uses test)
statistics.resampling: outer-split level within each predictor family (families use disjoint split seed namespaces per unit and are resampled independently); family means averaged within dataset, then equal weight across the three datasets (corrected 2026-10-09: earlier text wrongly assumed families share splits)
statistics.aggregation: average predictor families within dataset, then equal weight across the three datasets
statistics.interval_scope: random splits of these fixed datasets only; not a cross-dataset generalization interval

seed_registry.collision_check: namespaces disjoint by construction; assert at run time

leakage.rules: predictor fitted on train only; construction and grids use train labels only; selection uses val only; evaluate() is the sole consumer of test labels; sentineled copies (-1 outside mask) flow to method layer

pipeline_audit.node_diagnostic: seeds 51000-51999; descriptive (coverage + zero-change verification); questions fixed by advisor round 3
pipeline_audit.lgs_audit: seeds 52000-52999; descriptive; adaptations in notes/upgrade/lgs_audit.md; no channel deleted

minimal_repair_candidate.status: registered as follow-up research; NOT run (G4 method stop remains in force)
minimal_repair_candidate.design: for nodes lacking correction channels, restore/retain a small number of original/feature relations under a fixed edge budget; compare random repair, global softening, standard C&S; repair selection must not use test labels; must beat equal-budget plain repair to claim any algorithmic contribution; requires new confirmatory splits
